content.short: Game7 DAO is a decentralized autonomous organization dedicated to accelerating open-source gaming infrastructure and onchain game adoption on Mantle.
content.description: Game7 DAO is a community-governed organization focused on building and funding the open-source infrastructure needed for onchain gaming to reach its full potential. The DAO allocates capital and resources to developer tooling, gaming standards, educational content, and direct game development grants. By removing gatekeepers from game publishing and distribution through decentralized governance, Game7 aims to create a fair and open gaming ecosystem. The DAO's initiatives extend to the Mantle Network, where it supports gaming projects and developers.
content.meta: Game7 DAO funds and governs open-source onchain gaming infrastructure across ecosystems including Mantle. Discover Game7 DAO on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
